title: Normalized dual abelian variety and Poincare datum
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], and $A$ a group scheme over $k$ [def-sc-abelian-variety]. A normalized dual Poincare datum for $A$ consists of an abelian variety $D/k$ [def-sc-abelian-variety], an invertible module $P$ on $A\times_kD$ [def-sc-invertible-module], a trivialization of $P$ along $0\times D$, and triviality along $A\times0$. Every geometric fibre of $P$ is algebraically equivalent to the trivial module [def-sfb-line-algebraic-equivalence]. For every $k$-scheme $T$ and invertible $M$ on $A\times_kT$ algebraically trivial on every geometric fibre, with a specified identity-axis trivialization $r$, there is a unique map $f:T\to D$ for which $(1\times f)^*P$ is isomorphic to $M$ respecting the pullback of the specified trivialization. Pullback is the canonical inverse image of modules [def-pc-module-pullback]. Tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] of the families classified by $f,g:T\to D$ is classified by their sum. Write $e_T:T\to A\times T$ for $(0,1)$; its base-change rigidification is the composite of canonical pullback composition, equality and unit comparisons. Geometric fibre triviality means algebraic equivalence over every algebraically closed field $\Omega$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure] and every $\Omega$-point of $T$, with $A_\Omega$ regarded over $\Omega$. For an invertible $L$ on $A$, define its normalized difference to be $N_L=m^*L\otimes p_1^*(L^\vee)\otimes p_2^*(L^\vee)\otimes c^*(0^*L)$, where $c:A\times A\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and the dual is the sheaf Hom to the structure sheaf [def-sc-invertible-module]. A map $f:A\to D$ classifies the difference if $(1\times f)^*P\cong N_L$.
